purpose: Post-ranking falsification: test whether the frozen NULL_COUPLED winner can reproduce the held-out incremental-environment inferential-support pattern that was not included in the v1 scalar distance.

source_observed_support.multiplicity: omnibus is one unadjusted predeclared test per scope/scale; BH across the four block-specific tests separately within each scope/scale

validation_draws.fixed_environment_design: Azami run 33035785120 artifact 9632715852, de-geolocated by the already-frozen extractor

nested_test.method: Freedman-Lane reduced-model response-residual row permutation matching Azami PR72 logic
nested_test.within_rule: residual 18D response rows permuted only among observations of the same taxon
nested_test.among_rule: residual 18D response rows permuted across taxa
nested_test.block_rule: BH q across the four block-specific tests < 0.05
nested_test.note: 99 permutations are sufficient for binary alpha=0.05 support-state validation but are not used to reproduce the exact observed P-value magnitudes.

primary_held_out_pattern.name: replication_stable_scale_specific_process_support
primary_held_out_pattern.reason: These cells encode the replication-stable Azami result: no within-taxon process increment, but among-taxon omnibus and growing-season-water support at both replication thresholds.

secondary_diagnostics: within-supported and among-supported counts by threshold
marginal support frequency for every one of the 20 cells
stop_rule: Freeze the 64-draw result exactly as produced. Do not increase draws, change permutation count, redefine the primary pattern, alter the winner generator, or add the held-out support pattern back into the v1 score because of the outcome.
claim_boundary: This validation tests whether a frozen snapshot-null generator can reproduce the held-out binary inferential-support geometry. It cannot change the v1 winner and does not by itself identify a causal environmental process.
